description:
Swap windows between monitors with keyboard shortcuts.

• Swap the focused window with the window on the monitor above/below/left/right
• Move keyboard focus between monitors without touching the mouse
• Cycle through windows on the current monitor

All shortcuts are configurable in Settings.

Fork of dvrlabs/multimonitorswap ported to GNOME Shell 45+ (ESM), with fixes for silently-failing swap shortcuts.
name: Multi Monitor Swap (Jose fork)
